name: NOx control (SCR, SNCR, low-NOx burners)
principle: SCR injects ammonia or urea over a catalyst; SNCR injects it into the hot firebox without catalyst.

process_steps.name: Store and inject ammonia or urea
Reaction over catalyst (SCR) or in the firebox (SNCR)
Treated flue gas leaves; monitor ammonia slip
